answer: Voyage Bond Stake Decay stops one operator minting thousands of fakes. First, an agent locks 100 POA for 30 days before voting or attesting. Second, its bond decays by 2 POA per verified task, rewarding sustained work. Third, a fraud flag triggers an audit that freezes and burns half the bond. Fourth, a hollow account with no history earns nothing and borrows no reputation. An attacker running 1,000 fakes would need 100,000 POA, about $20,000, plus 30,000 tasks and 30 days of waiting. Like a walnut, real identity is hard to crack but easy to verify once opened.
